behavior_change: Executor currently writes a pre-wave directory checkpoint at .wabblespec/checkpoints/wave-N-timestamp/ before each wave (step 1), recording wave number, timestamp, and files to be touched; since all three fields are already declared in the locked wave plan, Executor should eliminate this pre-wave write and nominate the locked wave plan as the rollback ground truth, retaining only the post-wave session checkpoint at .wabblespec/session/checkpoints/checkpoint-wave-N.json.
risk: If a wave fails mid-implementation with no pre-wave directory checkpoint, rollback requires reverting all changes touched by the wave manually against the decompose state rather than restoring a per-wave snapshot; the wave plan declares intended file changes but not their pre-wave content.
rollback_condition: If post-failure manual intervention is required in more than 1 of 10 consecutive sessions after elimination, restore the pre-wave directory checkpoint write unconditionally.
secondary_change: Remove .wabblespec/checkpoints/* from executor authority.owns in skill-rules.json once pre-wave writes are eliminated; retain .wabblespec/session/checkpoints/* which covers the surviving post-wave checkpoint.
